Keep the two boundaries separate and add no guessed distance, payload, loss or storage factor. Complete native European rail/road/barge and ocean-container services are explicit geographic, traction/fleet/loading, fuel, infrastructure and vintage proxies. They do not establish identical logistics or scores.
